description: What the biome may be made of, do and know, hall by hall along the spine. Read by commons/biome_layers/biome_grammar.gd: a stage's closure is the union of every hall at or before it (order = curriculum_spine.json sequences, map_authored.json halls within a sequence) plus every sequence entry at or before its sequence. A word absent from the closure is not allowed in the cage. Three columns: made_of (geometry), does (time and behaviour), knows (record and readout). The visitor's hand is always allowed; the cage and its screen are furniture, not biome. `line` is the hall's own opening sentence, paraphrased; `beyond` is what the biome may say past what the hall wrote (Palle, 2026-09-17: 'you arrive late' — the biome as the opportunity to tell what is beyond what we wrote about). Design: doc/COMBINATORY_BIOME.md. Kingdom words (flower, fungus, tree, creature) are the arrival of a painted kingdom: flower with Color_Rainbow, fungus with randomness, tree and creature with lsystems. Per-hall entries exist for primitives, transformation and colour; the other sequences carry sequence-level words until their owners write the halls.

Point_One.line: You arrive late. One point; you can move it.
Point_One.beyond: the point was here before you. It has a place and no size; moving it is the only thing you can do to it, and it does not remember being moved.

Point_Lines.line: Two positions into relation; a line can be walked into being.
Point_Lines.beyond: a line has no thickness and no inside. What it divides it does not touch; move either end and it is already another line.

Point_Trace.line: Bring the detour: the floor remembers where the point has been, under a recording rule.
Point_Trace.beyond: a record is a choice of what to forget. This floor fades; a floor that did not would soon be one solid mark.

Point_Line_Grid.line: Many points on a grid, lines to neighbours.
Point_Line_Grid.beyond: a lattice is many points agreeing on a distance. Nothing in it is first, and the one you can move is the only one that can disagree.

Point_Triangle_Context.line: Three points close a boundary: the first surface.
Point_Triangle_Context.beyond: a face has two sides and a boundary that is not part of it. Seen edge-on it is a line again; that is the machine's addition, not yours.

Primitives_Polythedra.line: Faces meet and enclose: the first bodies.
Primitives_Polythedra.beyond: an inside exists only once the faces agree. The body is the agreement; take one face away and there is no inside, only a room.

Point_Animatedcube.line: Take hold of a corner; what must stay for it to remain a cube — and things may now move by themselves.
Point_Animatedcube.beyond: what moves by itself was already moving when you came in. You arrived late to that too; nothing here waits for a hand.

Primitives_Ignorance.line: The name sphere: round bodies, accepted as round.
Primitives_Ignorance.beyond: round is a limit nothing here reaches. Every sphere is faces that stopped; the name is where you agreed to stop counting.

Primitives_Portals.line: Add a division, then another: bodies of many parts, resolution as a property.
Primitives_Portals.beyond: divide again and the parts outnumber your attention before they outnumber the cage. Resolution is a budget, and it is spent on you.

Primitives_Melencolia.line: What keeps you looking after you know the form: a form for looking.
Primitives_Melencolia.beyond: a form can be kept after its use. Looking is not knowing; this one is here so the difference has somewhere to stand.

Trans_Pre.line: We leave primitives with a cube, a wedge and a grid; now a cube you can take.
Trans_Pre.beyond: a body you can take is still the body it was. Carrying is not a change to the thing; it is a change to where you are.

Trans_Introduction.line: A cube learned to rise, turn and swell; you could leave those movements running.
Trans_Introduction.beyond: a movement left running does not need you. It was a rule before it was a motion, and the rule keeps time without a witness.

Trans_Translation.line: A moving surface carried you across; here it is the thread through a longer space.
Trans_Translation.beyond: translation keeps every distance and every angle. What it changes is only where; nothing that rides it can tell it has moved.

Trans_Rotation.line: A surface stays attached to its middle. Follow one end; where does the other end go?
Trans_Rotation.beyond: one point on a turning thing does not move. Everything else moves in proportion to its distance from that point; the far end is always late.

Trans_Scale.line: You tried the openings against the size of your body; here something waits to be taken.
Trans_Scale.beyond: scaling keeps the shape and loses the size. A thing scaled to nothing is still that thing, and a thing scaled past the cage is too.

Trans_Body.line: The corridor narrows, and then it stops.
Trans_Body.beyond: the measure was you all along. Every opening was sized against a body that was not drawn; the post here is that body, drawn.

Trans_Pit.line: A wall can arrive on level ground. Wait beside its path, or step into the space it is about to occupy.
Trans_Pit.beyond: a boundary is a thing that moves. Compose two motions and the path is neither; where the wall will be is a question, not a place.

Color_Context_Placed.line: Colour joins the primitives: block, sphere, wedge, in columns, nothing moving.
Color_Context_Placed.beyond: colour arrived after every shape you know. It changes nothing a hand can find; the grey of the first cages was not an absence, it was the default.

Color_Flashlight.line: The colour is already there when you arrive: pools meet on a pale surface. Which lamp is responsible?
Color_Flashlight.beyond: a pool of colour is a lamp's claim on the floor. Where two claims meet, the colour belongs to neither; the edge is the only honest place.

Color_Nails.line: What changes when a colour becomes part of the body you act through?
Color_Nails.beyond: the point you move is coloured now, and so, from the point's side, are you. A colour worn is an address others read.

Color_Rainbow.line: The mushrooms are dressed for it: pearl collars, candy-coloured caps, stars beyond the arch.
Color_Rainbow.beyond: the first living thing arrives dressed. Nothing in it grew from the grey; it was let in because colour was, and a palette is a permission.

Color_Pillar.line: The hue stays while saturation rises; walk across the line and the hue changes too. Two directions.
Color_Pillar.beyond: a gradient is a colour that knows where it is. Read it in one direction and it is one thing; the field has as many stories as it has directions.

Color_Grid_Pallet.line: Choose a square before you choose a colour: two numbers give its address.
Color_Grid_Pallet.beyond: an address comes before a colour. The floor was addressable all along; naming a cell is what lets a colour stay where you put it.

Color_Paint.line: A coloured ball is already moving across the canvas; the pigment changes colour as it travels.
Color_Paint.beyond: the floor remembered in grey until now. A trace in colour is a record that also says when; the fade is the clock.

Color_Walls.line: A desk, a monitor, a chair; seven more places repeat. The glass has colour; the office has an order.
Color_Walls.beyond: the cage itself is not exempt. Colour reaches the furniture last, and the glass you looked through was never clear — only uncoloured.

Chamber_Color.line: A small instrument faces a crate in a frame. The aim is chosen; what remains is when.
Chamber_Color.beyond: everything here has been counted, coloured and placed; the one thing not decided is the moment. Time is the last material in this chapter.
